usedFor: Applivery receives builds and bug reports, and Microsoft Excel keeps them as table rows through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feedback Report” in Applivery, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Bug reports from testers land as rows you can sort and filter, instead of staying inside Applivery.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” writes into an Excel table, so create the table before the first run.
